        function formatExactDistance(km) {
            if (km < 1) return `${Math.max(10, Math.round(km * 1000))} m`;
            return `${km.toFixed(2)} km`;
        }

        function calcDistanceKm(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2) {
            const R = 6371;
            const dLat = (lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI / 180;
            const dLon = (lon2 - lon1) * Math.PI / 180;
            const a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 +
                      Math.cos(lat1 * Math.PI / 180) * Math.cos(lat2 * Math.PI / 180) *
                      Math.sin(dLon / 2) ** 2;
            return R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
        }

        function renderAuthState() {
            let user = window.FoodAPI ? FoodAPI.auth.getUser() : null;
            if (!user) {
                try {
                    const raw = localStorage.getItem('current_user') 
                             || localStorage.getItem('smart_dining_user') 
                             || localStorage.getItem('user')
                             || localStorage.getItem('foodai_demo_profile_state');
                    if (raw) user = JSON.parse(raw);
                } catch (_) {}
            }
            const token = localStorage.getItem('access_token') || localStorage.getItem('smart_dining_token');
            const isLoggedIn = Boolean(user && token);

            const show = (id, visible) => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.style.display = visible ? 'flex' : 'none';
            };

            const displayName = (isLoggedIn && user) ? (user.full_name || user.email || 'Tài khoản') : 'Khách';
            const displayEmail = (isLoggedIn && user) ? (user.email || user.phone_number || '') : 'Chưa đăng nhập';
            const displayRole = (isLoggedIn && user) ? (user.role === 'admin' ? 'Quản trị viên' : 'Thành viên') : 'Khách vãng lai';

            const navName = document.getElementById('nav-user-name');
            const dropName = document.getElementById('drop-user-name');
            const dropEmail = document.getElementById('drop-user-email');
            const dropRole = document.getElementById('drop-user-role');

            if (navName) navName.innerText = displayName;
            if (dropName) dropName.innerText = displayName;
            if (dropEmail) dropEmail.innerText = displayEmail;
            if (dropRole) dropRole.innerText = displayRole;

            const isAdmin = Boolean(isLoggedIn && user && (user.role === 'admin' || user.role === 'ADMIN'));
            const adminSec = document.getElementById('drop-admin-section');
            if (adminSec) adminSec.style.display = isAdmin ? 'block' : 'none';

            show('link-login', !isLoggedIn);
            show('link-register', !isLoggedIn);
            show('link-profile', isLoggedIn);
            show('link-preferences', isLoggedIn);
            show('link-admin', isAdmin);
            show('link-logout', isLoggedIn);
        }

        function syncProfileData() {
            renderAuthState();
            if (window.FoodAPI && FoodAPI.auth.isLoggedIn()) return;
            try {
                const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
                if (raw) {
                    const prof = JSON.parse(raw);
                    if (prof.full_name && document.getElementById('nav-user-name')) {
                        document.getElementById('nav-user-name').innerText = prof.full_name;
                    }
                    if (prof.avatar_url && document.getElementById('nav-user-avatar')) {
                        document.getElementById('nav-user-avatar').src = prof.avatar_url;
                    }
                }
            } catch (_) {}
        }

        async function refreshProfileFromServer() {
            if (!window.FoodAPI || !FoodAPI.auth.isLoggedIn()) return;
            try {
                const prof = await FoodAPI.profile.get();
                if (prof.full_name) {
                    if (document.getElementById('nav-user-name')) document.getElementById('nav-user-name').innerText = prof.full_name;
                    if (document.getElementById('drop-user-name')) document.getElementById('drop-user-name').innerText = prof.full_name;
                }
                if (prof.avatar_url && document.getElementById('nav-user-avatar')) {
                    document.getElementById('nav-user-avatar').src = prof.avatar_url;
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('[FoodAPI] Không tải được hồ sơ từ máy chủ:', err.message);
            }
        }

        async function handleLogoutFromIndex() {
            if (window.FoodAPI) await FoodAPI.auth.logout();
            localStorage.removeItem("access_token");
            localStorage.removeItem("current_user");
            localStorage.removeItem("smart_dining_token");
            localStorage.removeItem("smart_dining_user");
            localStorage.removeItem("user");
            localStorage.removeItem("foodai_demo_profile_state");
            window.location.reload();
        }

        async function loadVenuesFromApi() {
            try {
                if (window.FoodAPI) {
                    const rows = await FoodAPI.restaurants.listAll();
                    if (rows && rows.length > 0) {
                        venues = rows.map(FoodAPI.restaurants.toVenue);
                        renderVenues();
                    }
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('[FoodAPI] Dùng dữ liệu mẫu cục bộ do chưa kết nối được Backend:', err.message);
            }
        }

        function syncRadiusRibbonUI(km) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.radius-ribbon-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.toggle('active', parseFloat(btn.dataset.radius) === km);
            });
        }

        function updateMapRadiusSafe(km) {
            if (!mapComponent) return;
            if (typeof mapComponent.setRadiusKm === 'function') {
                mapComponent.setRadiusKm(km);
            } else if (typeof mapComponent.setSearchRadius === 'function') {
                mapComponent.setSearchRadius(km, true, false);
            }
        }

        function setSearchRadius(km) {
            searchRadiusKm = km;
            syncRadiusRibbonUI(km);
            updateMapRadiusSafe(km);
            updateActiveFilterBadge();
            renderVenues();
        }

        function toggleScrollSync() {
            scrollSyncEnabled = !scrollSyncEnabled;
            const btn = document.getElementById('btn-scroll-sync');
            if (btn) {
                btn.classList.toggle('active', scrollSyncEnabled);
                btn.innerText = scrollSyncEnabled ? '🔄 Đồng bộ khi cuộn' : '⏸️ Tạm tắt đồng bộ cuộn';
            }
        }

        function initMainMap() {
            mapComponent = new FoodAIMapComponent({
                containerId: 'main-map',
                defaultCenter: [10.776889, 106.700806],
                currentCenter: [currentPos.lat, currentPos.lng],
                defaultZoom: 14,
                minZoom: 5,
                maxZoom: 20,
                defaultRadiusKm: searchRadiusKm,
                radiusOptions: [1, 3, 5, 10],
                onLocationChange: async (pos) => {
                    currentPos = { lat: pos.lat, lng: pos.lng };
                    renderVenues();
                    const addrLabel = document.getElementById('current-address-label');
                    if (addrLabel && window.smartDiningLocationManager) {
                        const addr = await window.smartDiningLocationManager.reverseGeocode(pos.lat, pos.lng);
                        addrLabel.innerText = addr || `Tọa độ: ${pos.lat.toFixed(4)}, ${pos.lng.toFixed(4)}`;
                    } else if (addrLabel) {
                        addrLabel.innerText = `Tọa độ: ${pos.lat.toFixed(4)}, ${pos.lng.toFixed(4)}`;
                    }
                },
                onRadiusChange: (km) => {
                    searchRadiusKm = km;
                    syncRadiusRibbonUI(km);
                    renderVenues();
                },
                onVenueClick: (v) => {
                    scrollToAndHighlightCard(v.id);
                }
            });

            if (typeof LocationManager !== 'undefined') {
                window.smartDiningLocationManager = new LocationManager({
                    defaultRadiusKm: searchRadiusKm,
                    onLocationResolved: (resolved) => {
                        currentPos = { lat: resolved.lat, lng: resolved.lng };
                        const addrLabel = document.getElementById('current-address-label');
                        if (addrLabel) addrLabel.innerText = resolved.address;

                        if (mapComponent) {
                            mapComponent.flyToPosition(resolved.lat, resolved.lng, 14);
                        }
                        renderVenues();
                    },
                    onRadiusChanged: (radiusKm) => {
                        setSearchRadius(radiusKm);
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        function renderVenues(customList = null) {
            let list = customList ? [...customList] : [...venues];

            list = list.map(v => {
                const lat = parseFloat(v.lat !== undefined ? v.lat : v.latitude);
                const lng = parseFloat(v.lng !== undefined ? v.lng : v.longitude);
                const dist = (!isNaN(lat) && !isNaN(lng))
                    ? calcDistanceKm(currentPos.lat, currentPos.lng, lat, lng)
                    : (v.distance_km || 0);

                const rating = Number(v.rating || 4.5);
                const distScore = Math.max(0, 1 - dist / Math.max(1, searchRadiusKm));
                const ratingScore = rating / 5;
                const amenityScore = (v.parking ? 0.5 : 0) + (v.private_room ? 0.5 : 0);
                const totalScore = Math.round((distScore * 0.45 + ratingScore * 0.35 + amenityScore * 0.2) * 100);

                return {
                    ...v,
                    lat,
                    lng,
                    distanceKm: dist,
                    distance_km: dist,
                    matchScore: Math.min(99, Math.max(70, totalScore))
                };
            });

            if (!customList) {
                if (searchRadiusKm > 0) {
                    list = list.filter(v => v.distanceKm <= searchRadiusKm);
                }

                if (activeCategory !== 'all') {
                    const catTarget = activeCategory.toLowerCase();
                    list = list.filter(v => {
                        const c1 = (v.category || '').toLowerCase();
                        const c2 = (v.cuisineLabel || '').toLowerCase();
                        const n = (v.name || '').toLowerCase();
                        if (catTarget === 'món chay' || catTarget === 'vegan' || catTarget === 'đồ chay') {
                            return v.vegetarian || v.vegetarian_support || c1.includes('chay') || c1.includes('vegan') || c2.includes('chay');
                        }
                        if (catTarget === 'bbq hàn quốc' || catTarget === 'bbq' || catTarget === 'lẩu & bbq' || catTarget === 'nướng') {
                            return c1 === 'bbq' || c1.includes('nướng') || c2.includes('nướng') || c2.includes('bbq') || c1.includes('hotpot') || c2.includes('lẩu');
                        }
                        if (catTarget === 'cơm tấm') return c1.includes('cơm tấm') || c2.includes('cơm tấm') || n.includes('cơm tấm');
                        if (catTarget === 'cà phê' || catTarget === 'cafe') return c1.includes('cafe') || c2.includes('cà phê') || c2.includes('trà') || n.includes('cà phê');
                        if (catTarget === 'món âu' || catTarget === 'western') return c1 === 'western' || c2.includes('âu') || c2.includes('pizza') || c2.includes('pasta');
                        if (catTarget === 'món á' || catTarget === 'japanese' || catTarget === 'korean' || catTarget === 'chinese') {
                            return c1 === 'japanese' || c1 === 'korean' || c1 === 'chinese' || c2.includes('nhật') || c2.includes('hàn') || c2.includes('á');
                        }
                        return c1 === catTarget || c2.includes(catTarget) || n.includes(catTarget);
                    });
                }

                if (activeAmenities.parking) list = list.filter(v => (v.parking || v.has_parking));
                if (activeAmenities.private_room) list = list.filter(v => (v.private_room || v.has_private_room));
                if (activeAmenities.outdoor) list = list.filter(v => (v.outdoor || v.has_outdoor));
                if (activeAmenities.pet_friendly) list = list.filter(v => (v.pet_friendly || v.has_pet_friendly));
                if (activeAmenities.vegetarian) list = list.filter(v => (v.vegetarian || v.vegetarian_support));

                if (maxBudgetFilter) {
                    list = list.filter(v => (v.priceMin || 0) <= maxBudgetFilter);
                }

                if (minRatingFilter > 0) {
                    list = list.filter(v => (v.rating || 0) >= minRatingFilter);
                }
            }

            const sortMode = document.getElementById('sort-mode').value;
            if (sortMode === 'distance') list.sort((a, b) => a.distanceKm - b.distanceKm);
            else if (sortMode === 'rating') list.sort((a, b) => (b.rating || 0) - (a.rating || 0));
            else if (sortMode === 'price_asc') list.sort((a, b) => (a.priceMin || 0) - (b.priceMin || 0));
            else list.sort((a, b) => b.matchScore - a.matchScore);

            const heading = document.getElementById('results-heading');
            const subheading = document.getElementById('results-subheading');
            if (heading) {
                heading.innerText = `Tìm thấy ${list.length} địa điểm trong bán kính ${searchRadiusKm} km`;
            }
            if (subheading) {
                subheading.innerText = `Định tâm: ${currentPos.lat.toFixed(4)}, ${currentPos.lng.toFixed(4)} • Ghim bản đồ tự động đồng bộ khi cuộn`;
            }

            if (mapComponent) {
                mapComponent.setVenueMarkers(list);
            }

            const grid = document.getElementById('venues-grid');
            grid.innerHTML = '';

            if (list.length === 0) {
                grid.innerHTML = `
                    <div style="grid-column:1/-1;background:var(--bg-surface);border:1px dashed var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:32px;text-align:center;">
                        <p style="font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;">Chưa tìm thấy quán ăn phù hợp trong bán kính ${searchRadiusKm} km</p>
                        <p style="font-size:0.86rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:16px;">Bạn có thể mở rộng bán kính lên 5 km hoặc 10 km để xem thêm địa điểm quanh đây.</p>
                        <button type="button" class="btn-ai-ask" style="margin:0 auto;" onclick="setSearchRadius(10)">Mở rộng lên 10 km</button>
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }

            list.forEach(v => {
                const isSaved = savedIds.includes(v.id);
                const dist = v.distanceKm || 0;
                const travelMins = Math.max(2, Math.round(dist * 3.2));
                const distFormatted = formatExactDistance(dist);
                const rawImg = v.image || v.cover_image_url || "";
                const isBadImg = !rawImg || rawImg.includes("example.com");
                const imageUrl = isBadImg 
                    ? "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555396273-367ea4eb4db5?w=800" 
                    : rawImg;
                const priceMin = Number(v.priceMin || v.min_price || 50000);
                const priceMax = Number(v.priceMax || v.max_price || 300000);

                const card = document.createElement('article');
                card.className = `venue-card${activeSyncedVenueId === v.id ? ' active-sync' : ''}`;
                card.id = `venue-card-${v.id}`;
                card.setAttribute('data-venue-id', v.id);

                card.onmouseenter = () => {
                    if (scrollSyncEnabled && mapComponent) {
                        highlightCardElement(v.id);
                        mapComponent.highlightVenue(v.id, { panTo: false, openPopup: false });
                    }
                };

                card.onclick = () => {
                    highlightCardElement(v.id);
                    openVenueModal(v);
                    if (mapComponent) {
                        mapComponent.focusVenue(v.id);
                    }
                };

                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="venue-img-wrap">
                        <img src="${imageUrl}" alt="${v.name}" loading="lazy" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555396273-367ea4eb4db5?w=800';">
                        <span class="match-badge">Phù hợp ${v.matchScore}% • ${distFormatted}</span>
                        <button type="button" class="fav-btn ${isSaved ? 'saved' : ''}" onclick="toggleSaveVenue(event, ${v.id})">
                            ♥
                        </button>
                    </div>
                    <div class="venue-body">
                        <div class="venue-title-row">
                            <h3 class="venue-name">${v.name}</h3>
                            <span class="rating-pill">★ ${Number(v.rating || v.avg_rating || 4.5).toFixed(1)}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="venue-meta">
                            ${v.cuisineLabel || v.cuisine_type || v.category || "Nhà hàng"} • <strong style="color:var(--brand-red);">${distFormatted}</strong> (~${travelMins} phút) • ${priceMin.toLocaleString()}đ - ${priceMax.toLocaleString()}đ
                        </div>
                        <div style="font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:8px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;">
                            📍 ${v.address}
                        </div>
                        <div class="venue-tags">
                            ${(v.parking || v.has_parking) ? '<span class="venue-tag">🚗 Đỗ ô tô</span>' : ''}
                            ${(v.private_room || v.has_private_room) ? '<span class="venue-tag">🚪 Phòng riêng</span>' : ''}
                            ${(v.outdoor || v.has_outdoor) ? '<span class="venue-tag">🌿 Ngoài trời</span>' : ''}
                            ${(v.pet_friendly || v.has_pet_friendly) ? '<span class="venue-tag">🐾 Thú cưng</span>' : ''}
                            ${(v.vegetarian || v.vegetarian_support) ? '<span class="venue-tag">🌱 Món chay</span>' : ''}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
                grid.appendChild(card);
            });

            setupScrollSyncObserver();
        }

        function highlightCardElement(venueId) {
            if (activeSyncedVenueId !== null && activeSyncedVenueId !== venueId) {
                const prev = document.getElementById(`venue-card-${activeSyncedVenueId}`);
                if (prev) prev.classList.remove('active-sync');
            }
            activeSyncedVenueId = venueId;
            const current = document.getElementById(`venue-card-${venueId}`);
            if (current) current.classList.add('active-sync');
        }

        function scrollToAndHighlightCard(venueId) {
            highlightCardElement(venueId);
            const card = document.getElementById(`venue-card-${venueId}`);
            if (card) {
                isProgrammaticScroll = true;
                card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                setTimeout(() => { isProgrammaticScroll = false; }, 700);
            }
        }

        let scrollListenerBound = false;
        function setupScrollSyncObserver() {
            if (scrollListenerBound) return;
            scrollListenerBound = true;

            const onScrollHandler = () => {
                if (!scrollSyncEnabled || isProgrammaticScroll || !mapComponent) return;

                if (scrollSyncTimer) cancelAnimationFrame(scrollSyncTimer);
                scrollSyncTimer = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('#venues-grid .venue-card[data-venue-id]');
                    if (!cards.length) return;

                    const targetY = Math.min(window.innerHeight * 0.35, 240);
                    let bestCard = null;
                    let minDistanceToTarget = Infinity;

                    cards.forEach(card => {
                        const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
                        if (rect.bottom > 80 && rect.top < window.innerHeight - 60) {
                            const cardCenter = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
                            const dist = Math.abs(cardCenter - targetY);
                            if (dist < minDistanceToTarget) {
                                minDistanceToTarget = dist;
                                bestCard = card;
                            }
                        }
                    });

                    if (bestCard) {
                        const vid = parseInt(bestCard.getAttribute('data-venue-id'), 10);
                        if (!isNaN(vid) && vid !== activeSyncedVenueId) {
                            highlightCardElement(vid);
                            mapComponent.highlightVenue(vid, { panTo: true, openPopup: false });
                        }
                    }
                });
            };

            window.addEventListener('scroll', onScrollHandler, { passive: true });
        }

        function onDrawerBudgetSliderChange(val) {

                const maxVal = Number(btn.dataset.max);
                btn.classList.toggle('active', (num >= 1000000 && maxVal === 1000000) || maxVal === num);

        }

        function calcMatchCount(state) {
            let list = [...venues];
            const centerLat = currentPos.lat;
            const centerLng = currentPos.lng;
            const rad = state.radiusKm || searchRadiusKm;

            list = list.filter(v => {
                const lat = parseFloat(v.lat !== undefined ? v.lat : v.latitude);
                const lng = parseFloat(v.lng !== undefined ? v.lng : v.longitude);
                if (isNaN(lat) || isNaN(lng)) return false;
                const d = calcDistanceKm(centerLat, centerLng, lat, lng);
                return d <= rad;
            });

            if (state.cuisine && state.cuisine !== 'all') {
                const catTarget = state.cuisine.toLowerCase();
                list = list.filter(v => {
                    const c1 = (v.category || '').toLowerCase();
                    const c2 = (v.cuisineLabel || '').toLowerCase();
                    const n = (v.name || '').toLowerCase();
                    if (catTarget === 'món chay' || catTarget === 'vegan' || catTarget === 'đồ chay') {
                        return v.vegetarian || v.vegetarian_support || c1.includes('chay') || c1.includes('vegan') || c2.includes('chay');
                    }
                    if (catTarget === 'bbq hàn quốc' || catTarget === 'bbq' || catTarget === 'lẩu & bbq' || catTarget === 'nướng') {
                        return c1 === 'bbq' || c1.includes('nướng') || c2.includes('nướng') || c2.includes('bbq') || c1.includes('hotpot') || c2.includes('lẩu');
                    }
                    if (catTarget === 'cơm tấm') return c1.includes('cơm tấm') || c2.includes('cơm tấm') || n.includes('cơm tấm');
                    if (catTarget === 'cà phê' || catTarget === 'cafe') return c1.includes('cafe') || c2.includes('cà phê') || c2.includes('trà') || n.includes('cà phê');
                    if (catTarget === 'món âu' || catTarget === 'western') return c1 === 'western' || c2.includes('âu') || c2.includes('pizza') || c2.includes('pasta');
                    if (catTarget === 'món á' || catTarget === 'japanese' || catTarget === 'korean' || catTarget === 'chinese') {
                        return c1 === 'japanese' || c1 === 'korean' || c1 === 'chinese' || c2.includes('nhật') || c2.includes('hàn') || c2.includes('á');
                    }
                    return c1 === catTarget || c2.includes(catTarget) || n.includes(catTarget);
                });
            }

            if (state.amenities.parking) list = list.filter(v => (v.parking || v.has_parking));
            if (state.amenities.private_room) list = list.filter(v => (v.private_room || v.has_private_room));
            if (state.amenities.outdoor) list = list.filter(v => (v.outdoor || v.has_outdoor));
            if (state.amenities.pet_friendly) list = list.filter(v => (v.pet_friendly || v.has_pet_friendly));
            if (state.amenities.vegetarian) list = list.filter(v => (v.vegetarian || v.vegetarian_support));

            if (state.maxBudget) {
                list = list.filter(v => (v.priceMin || 0) <= state.maxBudget);
            }

            if (state.minRating > 0) {
                list = list.filter(v => (v.rating || 0) >= state.minRating);
            }

            return list.length;
        }

        function updateDrawerMatchCountPreview() {
            const count = calcMatchCount(tempDrawerState);
            const countEl = document.getElementById('drawer-match-count');
            if (countEl) countEl.innerText = count;

            const applyBtn = document.getElementById('drawer-btn-apply');
            if (applyBtn) {
                applyBtn.innerHTML = `Áp dụng bộ lọc (<span id="drawer-match-count">${count}</span> quán)`;
            }

            let amCount = 0;
            Object.values(tempDrawerState.amenities).forEach(v => { if (v) amCount++; });
            const amBadge = document.getElementById('drawer-amenity-count-badge');
            if (amBadge) amBadge.innerText = `${amCount} đã chọn`;
        }

            if (maxBudgetFilter !== null && maxBudgetFilter < 1000000) count++;

            if (minRatingFilter > 0) count++;

            if (activeAmenities.private_room) count++;
            if (activeAmenities.outdoor) count++;
            if (activeAmenities.pet_friendly) count++;
            if (activeAmenities.vegetarian) count++;

            const badge = document.getElementById('active-filter-count');
            const resetBtn = document.getElementById('btn-reset-filters');
            if (badge) {
                badge.innerText = count;
                badge.style.display = count > 0 ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
            }
            if (resetBtn) {
                resetBtn.style.display = count > 0 ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';
            }
        }

        async function fetchFilteredRestaurantsFromAPI() {
            try {
                const params = new URLSearchParams();
                if (activeCategory !== 'all') params.append('cuisine_type', activeCategory);
                if (maxBudgetFilter) params.append('price_max', maxBudgetFilter);
                if (currentPos && currentPos.lat && currentPos.lng) {
                    params.append('lat', currentPos.lat);
                    params.append('lng', currentPos.lng);
                }
                if (searchRadiusKm) params.append('radius_km', searchRadiusKm);
                if (minRatingFilter > 0) params.append('min_rating', minRatingFilter);

                if (activeAmenities.parking) params.append('has_parking', 'true');
                if (activeAmenities.private_room) params.append('has_private_room', 'true');
                if (activeAmenities.outdoor) params.append('has_outdoor', 'true');
                if (activeAmenities.pet_friendly) params.append('pet_friendly', 'true');
                if (activeAmenities.vegetarian) params.append('vegetarian_support', 'true');

                const sortMode = document.getElementById('sort-mode') ? document.getElementById('sort-mode').value : 'score';
                if (sortMode === 'distance') params.append('sort_by', 'distance');
                else if (sortMode === 'rating') params.append('sort_by', 'rating');
                else if (sortMode === 'price_asc') params.append('sort_by', 'price_asc');

                params.append('limit', '200');

                const res = await fetch(`/api/restaurants/filter?${params.toString()}`);
                if (res.ok) {
                    const json = await res.json();
                    if (json && json.data) {
                        const apiVenues = json.data.map(item => {
                            const am = item.amenities || {};
                            return {
                                id: item.id,
                                name: item.name,
                                address: item.address,
                                lat: parseFloat(item.latitude) || 10.8231,
                                lng: parseFloat(item.longitude) || 106.6900,
                                category: item.cuisine_type || 'other',
                                cuisineLabel: item.cuisine_type || 'Ẩm thực',
                                priceMin: item.min_price || 50000,
                                priceMax: item.max_price || 300000,
                                rating: item.avg_rating || 4.5,
                                reviews: item.total_reviews || 0,
                                parking: !!am.has_parking,
                                has_parking: !!am.has_parking,
                                private_room: !!am.has_private_room,
                                has_private_room: !!am.has_private_room,
                                outdoor: !!am.has_outdoor,
                                has_outdoor: !!am.has_outdoor,
                                pet_friendly: !!am.pet_friendly,
                                has_pet_friendly: !!am.pet_friendly,
                                vegetarian: !!am.vegetarian_support,
                                vegetarian_support: !!am.vegetarian_support,
                                distance_km: item.distance_km,
                                distanceKm: item.distance_km,
                                image: item.cover_image_url || "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1517248135467-4c7edcad34c4?auto=format&fit=crop&w=600&q=80",
                                image_url: item.cover_image_url || null
                            };
                        });
                        venues = apiVenues;
                        renderVenues(venues);
                    }
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('[BE Filter API] Backend offline hoặc lỗi, fallback sang bộ lọc client-side tức thì:', err);
            }
        }

        function executeAISearch(customPrompt = null) {
            const q = (customPrompt || document.getElementById('main-search-input').value).trim();
            document.getElementById('search-suggestions').classList.remove('open');
            if (!q) {
                renderVenues();
                return;
            }

            const lower = q.toLowerCase();
            activeCategory = 'all';
            if (lower.includes('nướng') || lower.includes('bbq')) activeCategory = 'bbq';
            else if (lower.includes('lẩu') || lower.includes('nấm')) activeCategory = 'hotpot';
            else if (lower.includes('chay')) activeCategory = 'vegan';
            else if (lower.includes('hải sản')) activeCategory = 'seafood';
            else if (lower.includes('sushi') || lower.includes('nhật')) activeCategory = 'japanese';

            activeAmenities.parking = lower.includes('ô tô') || lower.includes('đậu xe') || lower.includes('đỗ xe');
            activeAmenities.private_room = lower.includes('phòng riêng') || lower.includes('yên tĩnh');
            activeAmenities.vegetarian = lower.includes('chay');

            const priceMatch = lower.match(/(\d+)\s*(k|nghìn|triệu)/);
            if (priceMatch) {
                const val = parseInt(priceMatch[1]);
                maxBudgetFilter = priceMatch[2] === 'triệu' ? (val * 1000000) / 4 : val * 1000;
            } else {
                maxBudgetFilter = null;
            }

            const banner = document.getElementById('ai-banner');
            banner.classList.add('visible');
            document.getElementById('ai-banner-reason').innerText =
                `Đã phân tích yêu cầu "${q}": Ưu tiên các địa điểm ${activeCategory !== 'all' ? 'nhóm ' + activeCategory.toUpperCase() : ''} ${activeAmenities.parking ? 'có bãi đỗ ô tô, ' : ''}${activeAmenities.private_room ? 'có phòng riêng, ' : ''}xếp hạng theo khoảng cách gần vị trí của bạn nhất.`;

            updateActiveFilterBadge();
            renderVenues();
        }

        function showSuggestions() {
            document.getElementById('search-suggestions').classList.add('open');
        }

        function applyQuickQuery(text) {
            document.getElementById('main-search-input').value = text;
            executeAISearch(text);
        }

        function handleInstantSearch(val) {
            if (!val.trim()) {
                renderVenues();
                return;
            }
            const filtered = venues.filter(v =>
                v.name.toLowerCase().includes(val.toLowerCase()) ||
                (v.cuisineLabel && v.cuisineLabel.toLowerCase().includes(val.toLowerCase()))
            );
            renderVenues(filtered);
        }

        function openVenueModal(v) {
            const modal = document.getElementById('venue-modal');
            const box = document.getElementById('venue-modal-content');
            const lat = v.latitude || v.lat;
            const lng = v.longitude || v.lng;
            const gmapsUrl = `https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&origin=${currentPos.lat},${currentPos.lng}&destination=${lat},${lng}&travelmode=two-wheeler`;
            const rawImg = v.image || v.cover_image_url || "";
            const isBadImg = !rawImg || rawImg.includes("example.com");
            const imageUrl = isBadImg 
                ? "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555396273-367ea4eb4db5?w=800" 
                : rawImg;

            box.innerHTML = `
                <img src="${imageUrl}" onerror="this.onerror=null;this.src='https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555396273-367ea4eb4db5?w=800';" style="width:100%;height:210px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:16px;">
                <h3 style="font-size:1.3rem;margin-bottom:4px;">${v.name}</h3>
                <p style="font-size:0.86rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:12px;">${v.address} • Giờ mở cửa: ${v.openHours || '08:00 - 22:00'}</p>
                <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;">
                    <span class="venue-tag">★ ${Number(v.rating || v.avg_rating || 4.5).toFixed(1)} (${v.reviews || v.total_reviews || 0} đánh giá)</span>
                    <span class="venue-tag">Cách ${formatExactDistance(v.distanceKm !== undefined ? v.distanceKm : (v.distance_km || 0))}</span>
                    <span class="venue-tag">${Number(v.priceMin || v.min_price || 50000).toLocaleString()}đ - ${Number(v.priceMax || v.max_price || 300000).toLocaleString()}đ/người</span>
                </div>
                <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;">
                    <a href="${gmapsUrl}" target="_blank" class="btn-ai-ask" style="flex:1;height:40px;justify-content:center;text-decoration:none;border-radius:8px;">
                        Mở chỉ đường Google Maps
                    </a>
                    <button type="button" onclick="handleWriteReview(${v.id})"
                        style="height:40px;padding:0 14px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg-surface);color:var(--text-primary);cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;">
                        ⭐ Đánh giá
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" onclick="closeVenueModal()" style="height:40px;padding:0 18px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg-subtle);color:var(--text-primary);cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;">
                        Đóng
                    </button>
                </div>
            `;
            modal.classList.add('open');
        }

        function closeVenueModal() {
            document.getElementById('venue-modal').classList.remove('open');
        }

        function handleWriteReview(venueId) {
            if (window.GuestModeGuard && !window.GuestModeGuard.requireAuth('review')) return;
            alert('Mở form đánh giá cho nhà hàng #' + venueId + '!');
        }

        function toggleSaveVenue(e, id) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (window.GuestModeGuard && !window.GuestModeGuard.requireAuth('favorite')) return;
            const wasSaved = savedIds.includes(id);
            savedIds = wasSaved ? savedIds.filter(x => x !== id) : [...savedIds, id];
            localStorage.setItem('smart_dining_saved_venues', JSON.stringify(savedIds));
            renderVenues();
        }

        function filterSavedVenues() {
            if (window.GuestModeGuard && !window.GuestModeGuard.requireAuth('favorite')) return;
            document.getElementById('account-dropdown').classList.remove('open');
            const list = venues.filter(v => savedIds.includes(v.id));
            renderVenues(list);
        }

        function locateUserGPS() {
            if (window.smartDiningLocationManager) {
                window.smartDiningLocationManager.openManualModal();
            } else if (mapComponent) {
                mapComponent.locateUser();
            }
        }

        window.onMapPopupSelectVenue = function(venueId) {
            const v = venues.find(item => item.id === venueId);
            if (v) {
                const lat = parseFloat(v.lat !== undefined ? v.lat : v.latitude);
                const lng = parseFloat(v.lng !== undefined ? v.lng : v.longitude);
                const dist = (!isNaN(lat) && !isNaN(lng)) ? calcDistanceKm(currentPos.lat, currentPos.lng, lat, lng) : (v.distance_km || 0);
                openVenueModal({ ...v, distanceKm: dist, distance_km: dist });
            }
        };

        function toggleAccountDropdown() {
            document.getElementById('account-dropdown').classList.toggle('open');
        }

        async function initChatSessionIfNeeded() {
            if (currentChatSessionId) return;
            const user = window.FoodAPI ? FoodAPI.auth.getUser() : null;
            const userId = user && user.id ? user.id : null;
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/chat/sessions', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ user_id: userId })
                });
                if (res.ok) {
                    const data = await res.json();
                    currentChatSessionId = data.session_id;
                }
            } catch (_) {}
        }

        async function toggleAIDrawer() {
            const drawer = document.getElementById('ai-drawer');
            drawer.classList.toggle('open');
            if (drawer.classList.contains('open')) {
                await initChatSessionIfNeeded();
            }
        }

        let isSendingChat = false;

        async function sendDrawerMessage() {
            if (isSendingChat) return;

            const input = document.getElementById('drawer-input');
            const sendBtn = document.querySelector('#ai-drawer .ai-drawer-input button');
            const feed = document.getElementById('ai-chat-feed');
            const text = (input?.value || '').trim();
            if (!text || !feed) return;

            if (window.GuestModeGuard && !window.GuestModeGuard.consumeGuestChatTurn()) {
                return;
            }

            isSendingChat = true;
            input.value = '';
            input.disabled = true;
            if (sendBtn) sendBtn.disabled = true;

            const userBubble = document.createElement('div');
            userBubble.className = 'bubble bubble-user';
            userBubble.textContent = text;
            feed.appendChild(userBubble);

            const loadingBubble = document.createElement('div');
            loadingBubble.className = 'bubble bubble-ai';
            loadingBubble.innerHTML = '<em style="color:var(--text-muted);">🤖 Trợ lý AI đang phân tích & tìm quán phù hợp...</em>';
            feed.appendChild(loadingBubble);
            feed.scrollTop = feed.scrollHeight;

            try {
                await initChatSessionIfNeeded().catch(() => {});

                window.mapComponent = mapComponent;
                const result = await AIChatMapSync.fetchTopRecommendations(
                    text,
                    currentPos,
                    searchRadiusKm,
                    5,
                    currentChatSessionId,
                    venues
                );

                loadingBubble.remove();

                if (!result || result.blocked) return;

                const loc = result.resolvedLocation;
                if (loc && Number.isFinite(loc.latitude) && Number.isFinite(loc.longitude)) {
                    currentPos = { lat: loc.latitude, lng: loc.longitude };
                    if (mapComponent) {
                        mapComponent.setUserPosition(currentPos.lat, currentPos.lng, false);
                    }
                    if (typeof loc.source === 'string' && loc.source.startsWith('geocoded:')) {
                        const addrLabel = document.getElementById('current-address-label');
                        if (addrLabel) addrLabel.textContent = loc.source.replace('geocoded:', '').trim();
                    }
                }

                AIChatMapSync.syncResultsToChatAndMap(feed, mapComponent, result, (topList) => {
                    renderVenues(topList);
                });
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('[AI Chat Error]:', err);
                loadingBubble.innerHTML = 'Xin lỗi, hệ thống AI đang gặp sự cố kết nối. Bạn thử lại sau vài giây nhé!';
            } finally {
                isSendingChat = false;
                input.disabled = false;
                if (sendBtn) sendBtn.disabled = false;
                input.focus();
                feed.scrollTop = feed.scrollHeight;
            }
        }

        function toggleTheme() {
            const html = document.documentElement;
            const next = html.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
            html.setAttribute('data-theme', next);
        }

        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (!e.target.closest('.search-wrapper')) {
                document.getElementById('search-suggestions').classList.remove('open');
            }
            if (!e.target.closest('.topbar-right')) {
                document.getElementById('account-dropdown').classList.remove('open');
            }
        });

        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            syncProfileData();
            initMainMap();
            renderVenues();
            loadVenuesFromApi();
            refreshProfileFromServer();

            if (window.smartDiningLocationManager) {
                window.smartDiningLocationManager.requestBrowserGPS(true);
            }
        });

        function switchMobileView(mode) {
            const layout = document.querySelector('.discovery-layout');
            const btnList = document.getElementById('btn-view-list');
            const btnMap = document.getElementById('btn-view-map');
            if (!layout) return;

            if (mode === 'map') {
                layout.classList.remove('view-list');
                layout.classList.add('view-map');
                if (btnList) btnList.classList.remove('active');
                if (btnMap) btnMap.classList.add('active');
                if (mapComponent) mapComponent.invalidateSize();
            } else {
                layout.classList.remove('view-map');
                layout.classList.add('view-list');
                if (btnList) btnList.classList.add('active');
                if (btnMap) btnMap.classList.remove('active');
            }
        }
    </script>
    <div class="mobile-view-toggle-bar" id="mobile-view-toggle">
        <button type="button" class="mobile-view-btn active" id="btn-view-list" onclick="switchMobileView('list')">
            📋 Danh sách
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="mobile-view-btn" id="btn-view-map" onclick="switchMobileView('map')">
            🗺️ Bản đồ
        </button>
    </div>
    <script src="js/guest-mode.js"></script>
    <script src="js/ai-chat-map-sync.js"></script>
</body>
</html>

        function togglePasswordVisibility(inputId, btn) {
            const input = document.getElementById(inputId);
            const isPassword = input.type === 'password';
            input.type = isPassword ? 'text' : 'password';
            btn.innerHTML = isPassword
                ? `<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M17.94 17.94A10.07 10.07 0 0 1 12 20c-7 0-11-8-11-8a18.45 18.45 0 0 1 5.06-5.94M9.9 4.24A9.12 9.12 0 0 1 12 4c7 0 11 8 11 8a18.5 18.5 0 0 1-2.16 3.19m-6.72-1.07a3 3 0 1 1-4.24-4.24"/><line x1="1" y1="1" x2="23" y2="23"/></svg>`
                : `<svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M1 12s4-8 11-8 11 8 11 8-4 8-11 8-11-8z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg>`;
        }

        function quickFill(account, password) {
            document.getElementById('login-account').value = account;
            document.getElementById('login-password').value = password;
            document.querySelectorAll('.form-feedback').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
            document.querySelectorAll('.form-input').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('has-error'));
            const errorBanner = document.getElementById('login-error-banner');
            if (errorBanner) errorBanner.style.display = 'none';
            if (typeof showToast === 'function') {
                showToast('info', `Đã điền tài khoản: ${account}`);
            }
        }

        // Check URL query parameters for registration success
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            if (params.get('registered') === 'success') {
                const banner = document.getElementById('register-success-banner');
                banner.style.display = 'flex';
                const emailParam = params.get('email');
                if (emailParam) {
                    document.getElementById('login-account').value = decodeURIComponent(emailParam);
                    document.getElementById('login-password').focus();
                }
            }
        });

        async function handleLoginSubmit(e) {
            e.preventDefault();

            const accountInput = document.getElementById('login-account').value.trim();
            const passwordInput = document.getElementById('login-password').value;

            // Reset errors
            document.querySelectorAll('.form-feedback').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
            document.querySelectorAll('.form-input').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('has-error'));
            const errorBanner = document.getElementById('login-error-banner');
            errorBanner.style.display = 'none';

            let isValid = true;
            if (!accountInput) {
                document.getElementById('error-account').style.display = 'flex';
                document.getElementById('login-account').classList.add('has-error');
                isValid = false;
            }

            if (!passwordInput) {
                document.getElementById('error-password').style.display = 'flex';
                document.getElementById('login-password').classList.add('has-error');
                isValid = false;
            }

            if (!isValid) return;

            const submitBtn = document.getElementById('btn-submit-login');
            submitBtn.classList.add('btn-loading');

            const isEmail = accountInput.includes('@');
            const payload = {
                email: isEmail ? accountInput : null,
                phone_number: !isEmail ? accountInput : null,
                password: passwordInput
            };

            try {
                const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/auth/login', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });

                const data = await response.json();

                if (!response.ok) {
                    const detail = data.detail || 'Đăng nhập không thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại tài khoản hoặc mật khẩu.';
                    document.getElementById('login-error-text').textContent = detail;
                    errorBanner.style.display = 'flex';
                    return;
                }

                // Lưu thông tin người dùng và token đồng bộ trên tất cả các khóa
                const tokenStr = data.token || (data.tokens && data.tokens.access_token) || "";
                if (typeof setAuthSession === 'function') {
                    setAuthSession(data.user, tokenStr);
                }
                localStorage.setItem('access_token', tokenStr);
                localStorage.setItem('smart_dining_token', tokenStr);
                localStorage.setItem('current_user', JSON.stringify(data.user));
                localStorage.setItem('smart_dining_user', JSON.stringify(data.user));
                localStorage.setItem('user_id', String(data.user.id));
                localStorage.setItem('auth_token', tokenStr);
                localStorage.setItem('foodai_access_token', tokenStr);
                localStorage.setItem('foodai_demo_profile_state', JSON.stringify({
                    id: data.user.id,
                    full_name: data.user.full_name,
                    email: data.user.email,
                    role: data.user.role,
                    avatar_url: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1534528741775-53994a69daeb?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80"
                }));

                showToast('success', `Chào mừng ${data.user.full_name} quay trở lại!`, 'Đăng nhập thành công');

                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.href = '/';
                }, 800);

            } catch (err) {
                document.getElementById('login-error-text').textContent = 'Lỗi kết nối tới máy chủ: ' + err.message;
                errorBanner.style.display = 'flex';
            } finally {
                submitBtn.classList.remove('btn-loading');
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>


================================================================================
